provider.name: Wikipedia
provider.organization_type: collaborative multilingual encyclopedia, article, revision, citation, template, category, taxonomy-summary, API, dump, event-stream, offline-access, and Wikimedia integration infrastructure
provider.description: Wikipedia is a collaboratively edited multilingual encyclopedia built on MediaWiki. For Speciedex, it is a secondary explanatory and cross-reference source for taxa, common names, classification summaries, morphology, ecology, distribution, conservation, references, external identifiers, media, article histories, categories, templates, APIs, dumps, and Wikidata links.
institutional_context: Wikimedia Deutschland and other Wikimedia affiliates
MediaWiki, Wikidata, Wikimedia Commons, Wikispecies, Toolforge, and Wikimedia technical infrastructure

purpose.summary: This file is a crawl-ready source catalog for collecting Wikipedia documentation, governance, article and revision structure, editorial policies, citations, taxoboxes, taxonomy conventions, categories, templates, APIs, REST services, dumps, recent-change streams, offline archives, quality-control workflows, licenses, software, standards, tools, and related authorities.
purpose.authoritative_notice: Wikipedia is a tertiary, community-edited source and is not authoritative for taxonomy, nomenclature, legal status, conservation assessments, clinical guidance, or primary scientific claims. Article revisions, source citations, Wikimedia policies, MediaWiki documentation, dump manifests, Wikidata, Commons file pages, and original external authorities remain authoritative for their respective identifiers, versions, rights, and provenance.
